Title: Enable replication for added Azure VM data disks

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery now supports enabling replication for data disks that you add to an Azure VM that's already enabled for disaster recovery. Support is available for Azure VMs with managed disks. 

Read the detailed documentation.
